from __future__ import annotations

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class AliasParent(BaseModel):
    old: int = Field(1, title='Old')


class AliasPairParent(AliasParent):
    old: int = Field(1, title='Old')
    old_other: int = Field(4, title='Old Other')


class AliasPairChild(AliasPairParent):
    old: int = Field(2, alias='new', title='New')
    old_other: int = Field(5, alias='new_other', title='New Other')


class AliasPairGrandChild(AliasPairChild):
    old: int = Field(3, alias='newest', title='Newest')
    old_other: int = Field(6, alias='newest_other', title='Newest Other')
